# External Shot Continuity

Before creating a downstream shot, compare character identity, wardrobe,
location, lighting direction, time of day, and selected upstream visual anchors.
Reuse approved artifacts whenever they remain valid. If a change invalidates a
downstream shot, ask the Planner to mark only dependent assets stale and
regenerate the smallest valid set.
